Step card module

Source: R/modules.R
kit_stepcards_ui.Rd

Use when a page has several steps that must be done in order: only one step is open at a time; finished steps collapse to one line (✓, summary, "改" ("Edit")), and steps not yet available are gray. Each step ends with "對，下一步" ("Yes, next step") (a regular button); pressing it marks the step done and opens the next unfinished step. Press "改" on a finished step to go back.

Usage

kit_stepcards_ui(id, ..., next_label = "對，下一步")

kit_stepcards_server(
  id,
  titles,
  summaries = list(),
  checks = list(),
  start = 1L
)

Arguments

id

The module id.

...

The content of each step (one tag or tagList() per step, in order).

next_label

The button text at the bottom of each step.

titles

The title of each step (character vector, length = number of steps).

summaries

The summary shown when each step is done: a list, one per step (a string, function, or reactive; NULL shows nothing).

checks

Checks before "對，下一步" ("Yes, next step") is pressed: a list, one function per step, returning what is still needed (character vector; length 0 = can move on). While something is still needed, the step is not done, and "還差：…" ("Still needed: …") is listed above the button (kit_problems()).

start

Which step is open at the start.

Value

kit_stepcards_ui(): a tagList() of kit_step_card()s.

kit_stepcards_server(): a list,

  • current: a reactive, which step is open now (0 when all are done);

  • done: a reactive, whether each step is done (logical vector);

  • open(k): opens step k (for example, back to step 1 when the data change);

  • reset(): marks all steps as not done and opens step 1.

Details

kit_stepcards_ui() holds the content of each step (in order); kit_stepcards_server() gives each step's title, its summary when done, and the check before "對，下一步" is pressed.

See also

kit_step_card(), kit_step_head() (low-level)

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  ui <- kit_page("KIT 示範", NULL,
    kit_stepcards_ui("steps",
      shiny::p("每個檔案是哪個世代、哪個波次。"),
      shiny::p("哪些欄是題目。"),
      shiny::p("計分檢查。")
    )
  )
  server <- function(input, output, session) {
    steps <- kit_stepcards_server("steps",
      titles = c("每個檔案是哪個世代、哪個波次", "哪些欄是題目", "計分檢查"),
      summaries = list("5 個檔案", function() "45 題", "沒有要決定的事")
    )
  }
  shiny::shinyApp(ui, server)
}
